summary: Implements the Custom Report Request feature/page. Allows users to request and configure custom reports by capturing parameters such as report type, purpose, audience, date ranges, programs, cohorts, courses, sites, agencies, statuses, and authorization details. Supports file upload for student authorization. Handles creation and editing of requests, validation, parameter lists by report type, and rendering of complex, multi-type web forms.
purpose: Enables users to submit requests for custom reports tailored to various entities (students, staff, sites/services). Collects required criteria/input via dynamic forms and validates according to business and security rules. Allows for administrative and user-based report definition and submission.

workflows.name: Custom Report Request Submission
steps: Display and initialize the request form, pre-populating fields for existing requests.
User selects report type (Placement Requests, Student, Student PR History, Staff, Site, Other).
Depending on report type, display appropriate input controls (department, program, cohort, site, agency, etc.).
User enters required information: purpose, audience, report parameters, optional past details.
If Student PR History: require information fields, authorization text or file upload.
If Placement Requests: select programs/sites, statuses, release filters.
If Staff: select departments, list data fields.
If Site/Services: select agencies/sites/services, specify data fields.
Perform client and server-side validation (required fields, date formats, permissions).
Save or update the CustomReport with associated parameters.
Display errors or confirmation as appropriate.

business_rules: Required fields (purpose, audience, requested date, etc.) must be entered.
Data fields entry is mandatory for all report types.
Student Authorization (text or file) is required for Student PR History requests.
At least one site, agency, program, department, or service must be selected when relevant.
Only Placement Coordinators can request for all placements; other users may have restricted access.
Submit button enabled only for authorized users and pending or new requests.
validations: Required field validators for all mandatory inputs.
Regular expression validators for date fields.
CustomValidator for requested date (must be today or future unless user is sysadmin).
File upload validation (only allowed types, e.g., PDF).
OnSave, checks for business rule compliance and displays errors using UserSession.Messages.
calculations: Auto-population of user, agency, and department fields based on session.
Resetting of date fields based on chosen term (via resetDates JS and backend logic).
conditions: If report type = 'Placement Requests' and Placement Coordinator: show programs views. Else show sites.
If report type = 'Student PR History': require consent fields and/or file upload.
If report for existing CustomReport, prefill all controls and lock certain fields if finalized.
JavaScript controls presentation and validation according to selected report type.
system_behavior: Dynamically switches form panels/views based on user input.
Enables/disables controls according to user rights and report state.
Handles postbacks to keep form state consistent.
Registers client-side scripts for UI features (calendar, bulk select, dynamic fields).
Saves/updates report and parameters to backend on submit.
Uploads files to server and stores references for authorization documents.
dependencies: CustomReport, Staff, Agencies, Sites, Departments, Programs data access APIs
Codes for dropdowns (e.g., report types, status codes)
exceptions: Invalid or missing required input: returns error message, halts submission.
File upload errors: returns message, prevents file save.
Unauthorized access: user prevented from saving or editing requests.
Backend/data errors: error displayed in error panel.
